name: Sumita Arika
source:
Jun's girlfriend, Arika is in the same group of friends as him. She's a beautiful girl who's meek and easily swept away in the moment. Arika still lives with her parents, but she stays over Jun's place a few days a week.

[Translated from her [URL=http://www.elle-murakami.com/murakami/01/m27/m27.html]official website profile[/URL].]
